observations: Photos show multiple wooden pallet bases/crates used for stacking.
Several pallets have circular stamp marks reading “EPAL”.
Some pallets look dusty/used; photo 2 shows visible wear and some boards that look rough/uneven.
No clear count of pallets, dimensions, or whether they are heat-treated/grade is shown beyond the EPAL stamp.

claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show wooden pallets arranged for stacking.

claims.claim: It available for pickup only in Port Harcourt
claims.evidence: No photo evidence of location; seller text only.

risks.risk: Quantity is unclear (how many pallets are included).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo showing the full stack with a visible count (or a written count) and/or a close-up of pallet ends showing total number.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the smallest reasonable quantity shown (worst-case for buyer).

risks.risk: Condition/repair status (broken boards, missing slats, loose nails) affects usability and price.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of the worst-damaged corners and underside of at least 2-3 pallets (including any cracked boards).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/possibly needing minor repair.

risks.risk: EPAL authenticity/grade and whether they are heat-treated (HT) for export/food use.
risks.proof: Request photos of the full stamp area(s) including any “HT” mark and the full pallet ID/markings on multiple pallets.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used pallets (not confirmed export/HT grade).

risks.risk: Size/type (standard pallet size vs other variants) is not confirmed.
risks.proof: Request a tape-measure photo showing length and width of one pallet (top view) and height.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard pallet size only if assumed; otherwise treated as unknown variant.

proof_requests: How many pallets are included? (provide a written count and a photo showing the whole quantity).
Close-up photos of the most damaged pallets (corners + underside).
Photos of the complete EPAL/ID stamps and any “HT” marking on at least 2 pallets.
Tape-measure photo for length, width, and height of one pallet.
response.reason: The item type is clear (EPAL-stamped wooden pallets for stacking), but the key pricing drivers—exact quantity, condition, and confirmed grade/HT—are not verifiable from the photos provided.
